name: DON'T BREATHE
source:
The story of a cheerful guy named Ace who works in the porn industry. Ace doesn't really think about who he sleeps with or builds relationships. All he thinks about is how to hook up with the next chick. Halloween is coming up soon, and to celebrate, Ace's boss decided to film a porn movie in an old mansion. It would seem that nothing bad could happen in an old mansion on the edge of the world. That's what Ace is about to find out. 

[From [url=https://alisindra.itch.io/dont-breathe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫艾斯的开朗家伙在色情行业工作的故事。艾斯并没有真正考虑他和谁上床或建立关系。他所想的只是如何勾搭下一个小妞。万圣节即将到来，为了庆祝，艾斯的老板决定在一座老宅子里拍摄一部色情电影。看起来，在世界边缘的一座古老宅邸里，不会发生什么不好的事情。这就是艾斯要找出的答案。
